name: Person by ID
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {person_id: 'P000001'}) RETURN p.birth_date, p.gender, p.race

name: Total persons
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(p) AS total_persons

name: Gender distribution
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.gender IS NOT NULL RETURN p.gender, count(p) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

name: Race distribution
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.race IS NOT NULL RETURN p.race, count(p) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

name: State distribution
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.state IS NOT NULL RETURN p.state, count(p) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

name: Total visits
cypher: MATCH (v:Visit) RETURN count(v) AS total_visits

name: Visit class distribution
cypher: MATCH (v:Visit) WHERE v.encounter_class IS NOT NULL RETURN v.encounter_class, count(v) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

name: Patient visits
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:VISITED]->(v:Visit) WITH p, count(v) AS visits ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN p.person_id, visits

name: Total conditions
cypher: MATCH (c:ConditionOccurrence) RETURN count(c) AS total_conditions

name: Top conditions
cypher: MATCH (c:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c.condition_concept IS NOT NULL RETURN c.condition_concept, count(c) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15

name: Diabetes patients
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Diabetes' WITH p RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS diabetic_patients

name: Hypertension patients
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Hypertension' RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS hypertensive_patients

name: Total medications
cypher: MATCH (m:DrugExposure) RETURN count(m) AS total_medications

name: Top prescribed drugs
cypher: MATCH (m:DrugExposure) WHERE m.drug_name IS NOT NULL RETURN m.drug_name, count(m) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15

name: Total procedures
cypher: MATCH (p:ProcedureOccurrence) RETURN count(p) AS total_procedures

name: Top procedures
cypher: MATCH (p:ProcedureOccurrence) WHERE p.description IS NOT NULL RETURN p.description, count(p) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15

name: Total measurements
cypher: MATCH (m:Measurement) RETURN count(m) AS total_measurements

name: Top lab tests
cypher: MATCH (m:Measurement) WHERE m.description IS NOT NULL RETURN m.description, count(m) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15

name: Comorbidity pairs
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c1:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c1.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Diabetes' WITH p LIMIT 1000 MATCH (p)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c2:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c2.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Hypertension' RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS comorbid_patients

name: Patient drug count
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(m:DrugExposure) WITH p, count(m) AS meds ORDER BY meds DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN p.person_id, meds

name: Patient condition count
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence) WITH p, count(c) AS conditions ORDER BY conditions DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN p.person_id, conditions

name: Expensive visits
cypher: MATCH (v:Visit) WHERE v.cost > 10000 RETURN v.encounter_class, v.cost, v.description ORDER BY v.cost DESC LIMIT 10

name: Average visit cost
cypher: MATCH (v:Visit) WHERE v.cost > 0 RETURN avg(v.cost) AS avg_cost

name: OMOP node label counts
cypher: MATCH (n:Person) RETURN 'Person' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:Visit) RETURN 'Visit' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:ConditionOccurrence) RETURN 'ConditionOccurrence' AS label, count(n) AS cnt

name: OMOP edge type counts
cypher: MATCH ()-[r:VISITED]->() RETURN 'VISITED' AS edge, count(r) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH ()-[r:HAS_CONDITION]->() RETURN 'HAS_CONDITION' AS edge, count(r) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH ()-[r:PRESCRIBED]->() RETURN 'PRESCRIBED' AS edge, count(r) AS cnt

name: Asthma treatment drugs
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Asthma' WITH p LIMIT 500 MATCH (p)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(m:DrugExposure) RETURN m.drug_name, count(m) AS prescriptions ORDER BY prescriptions DESC LIMIT 10

name: Depression comorbidities
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c1:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c1.condition_concept IS NOT NULL AND c1.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Depression' MATCH (p)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c2:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c2.condition_concept IS NOT NULL AND NOT (c2.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Depression') WITH c2.condition_concept AS condition, count(DISTINCT p) AS patients ORDER BY patients DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN condition, patients

name: Patient journey length
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:VISITED]->(v:Visit) WITH p, count(v) AS journey_len RETURN avg(journey_len) AS avg_visits_per_patient

name: Ambulatory vs inpatient
cypher: MATCH (v:Visit) WHERE v.encounter_class IN ['ambulatory', 'inpatient', 'emergency'] RETURN v.encounter_class, count(v) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

name: Polypharmacy patients (5+ drugs)
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(m:DrugExposure) WITH p, count(DISTINCT m.drug_name) AS unique_drugs WHERE unique_drugs >= 5 RETURN count(p) AS polypharmacy_patients
